summary: Quiet bend kerb with homes close behind; best at the west end.

best_section.where: Dobell Street north kerb at the west end of the bend, under street trees

drivers.seclusion: Gardens and houses lie just behind the kerb; the nearest dwellings are about 9-12 m away, with more across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed residential street; cars park on the kerb on the south side, so there is room for a van.
drivers.traffic: Quiet cul-de-sac style residential street, light traffic.
drivers.convention: Residents park on the street; no camping convention.

flags: Dwelling about 9 m from the kerb near 19 m; 6 m near 34 m
Low-lying: about 8 m elevation, unnamed waterway 134 m away
sun_shade: Street trees shade the west end, mainly from the north; the rest is open.
